_about: Quotes verified against the Elden Ring wikis (Fextralife + Fandom). Times are seconds into the edit (song from 0:34.06). 'shot' holds one image for the whole line. To add real voice lines, put clips in examples/elden_ring/voices/ and add "audio": "voices/<file>" to an entry (optional "gain", "audio_at").

captions.speaker: White Mask Varré
captions.text: Tarnished, are we? Unfortunately for you, however, you are maidenless.

captions.speaker: Margit, the Fell Omen
captions.text: Foul Tarnished, in search of the Elden Ring.

captions.speaker: Godrick the Grafted
captions.text: Lowly Tarnished… thou'rt unfit even to graft.

captions.speaker: Ranni the Witch
captions.text: A pleasure to meet thee, Tarnished. I am the witch Renna.

captions.speaker: Maliketh, the Black Blade
captions.text: Witless Tarnished… Why covet Destined Death?

captions.speaker: Miquella
captions.text: Tarnished one. Aspiring Lord of the old order.

captions.speaker: Hoarah Loux
captions.text: Brave Tarnished. Thy strength befits a crown.
